title: On-premises lakehouse reference architecture for banks
summary: An on-premises data lakehouse reference architecture for banks: Kubernetes topology, Iceberg storage layout, network zones, and the controls auditors ask about.
body_markdown:
An on-premises data lakehouse is a lakehouse architecture – open table formats over object storage with decoupled compute – deployed inside an organization's own data centers rather than a vendor's cloud.


The data, compute, and encryption keys all remain within infrastructure the organization controls, which is what separates it from a managed service running in a chosen region. IOMETE deploys this way by default, running Apache Spark on the customer's own Kubernetes clusters against Apache Iceberg tables on S3-compatible storage.
